_comment: Copy this to  %AppData%\Perch\supabase.local.json  (or %AppData%\Perch (Dev)\ for a dev build) and fill in your project's values. This path is OUTSIDE the repo, so it can't be committed. Alternatively set the PERCH_SUPABASE_URL / PERCH_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars. Use the anon/publishable key only — never the service_role/secret key.
